newsitem.title: USA: Southern to market electric vehicle charger.
newsitem.headline: Southern to market electric vehicle charger.

text.p: Southern Co said Tuesday it will market and service Delco Electronics Magne Charge electric vehicle chargers in Alabama, Georgia, Mississippi and the panhandle of Florida.
The Magne Charge marketing venture is a partnership with Dominion Resources Inc's Virginia Power, which sells the chargers in the Southeast outside Southern Co's four-state territory.
The chargers produced by General Motors Corp's Delco cost between $2,000 and $3,000.

Southern said it will initially market the system to fleet owners. The company also is developing a public charging infrastructure in Atlanta, placing public access chargers at Perimeter Mall and the Dunwoody, West End and Lindbergh Metropolitan Atlanta Rapid Transit Authority (MARTA) stations.
Southern said it also plans to install chargers at Lenox Mall and is evaluating other public access locations.
